summary.headline: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR 53.8 crore; standalone revenue up 7.8% YoY to INR 42 crore, Ind AS EBITDA margin 56.3% consolidated.
summary.overview: Standalone workspace revenue rose 7.8% YoY to INR 42 crore, with consolidated revenue at INR 53.8 crore and Ind AS consolidated EBITDA up 14.7% to INR 30.3 crore. Operational portfolio grew to 1.13 million sq ft (17,294 seats, 27 centers, 12 cities) with occupancy at 91.93%. Post-quarter, the company raised INR 100 crore of 11.75% secured NCDs (36 months) and encumbered about 19.65% of equity, with promoter holding stated at 36.81%. Management highlighted a pipeline of 2.31 million sq ft signed for future consumption, though analyst questions on Ahmedabad per-sq-ft economics, lease-inclusive leverage and Q4 margin drop were answered only partially.

segments.name: Managed workspace (standalone)
segments.commentary: INR 42 crore revenue, recurring; occupied seats 15,899 vs 12,534 YoY; occupancy 91.93% vs 88.6%. Enterprise clients ~70% of revenue vs 52% a year ago; revenue-to-rent 2.63x.

segments.name: Needle & Thread (design and build)
segments.commentary: Balance of consolidated revenue (about INR 11.8 crore implied), one-time in nature and booked on project completion/milestone under Ind AS. FY26 one-time revenue was INR 57 crore per management.

segments.name: Tier 2 cities
segments.commentary: About 80% of operational SBA in Tier 2 cities, contributing ~74% of standalone revenue in the quarter.

guidance_outlook: Management expects revenue from signed capacity to progressively show up as centers move into operation; no numerical revenue guidance given.

Ahmedabad development-management project (~8.6 lakh sq ft, Ambli Bopal Road): fit-out capex ~INR 100 crore, expected ~8,500 seats and ~INR 120 crore revenue potential once handed over; no timeline stated.
Total identified portfolio ~3.63 million sq ft across 40 centers with 52,000+ operational seats; FY27 framed as year of executing signed assets and expanding into new territories.
INR 100 crore NCD to reflect in financials from Q2 onwards; ~INR 55 crore of existing debt repaid.
Global tokenization platform being set up outside India; entity incorporation commenced, no timeline given.
capex_capacity: Operational 1.13 million sq ft; 0.19 million sq ft under fit-out; 2.31 million sq ft signed for future consumption (total identified ~3.63 million sq ft, 40 centers).

Management said ~12 lakh sq ft operational area of which ~75% is company-built, roughly 9 lakh sq ft at ~INR 1,300/sq ft, i.e., ~INR 118 crore of fit-out investment to date (excluding refurbishment and deposits on future sites).
Development-management model covers ~1.4 million sq ft across Ahmedabad and Jaipur.
New-center ramp: 75-90 days from handover to client fit-out; ~6-9 months to maturity, per management.
Management said unspent IPO proceeds are still with the company and will be deployed as properties under construction are handed over.
demand_pricing: Ahmedabad realisations management cited at INR 100-125 per sq ft per month for a full operating year; Capital One (~3.15 lakh sq ft, 95% pre-leased) became operational toward end FY26.
Analyst's implied Capital One figure of ~INR 1,044/sq ft/yr was reconciled by management to ~INR 87/sq ft/month in year one, reflecting rent-free and fit-out periods; 8-9 billable months assumed.
Enterprise/GCC demand: management said it is in talks with clients for full-spectrum GCC solutions in Bangalore and Hyderabad.
Scalex Advisory (GCC full-service JV, ~12% stake held by DevX) to focus on GIFT City; managed-office GCC leads to be redirected to DevX.
